title: Start and stop come from the Link session; Apricity never starts or stops the DAW
description:
As a performer, I want the DAW's play and stop to start and stop Apricity, while Apricity's own controls never start or stop my DAW, so that the DAW stays in charge.

Spec file: `features/link/play.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: Start and stop come from the Link session

  Scenario: Waiting for the session to start
    Given a Link session at 120 BPM with 1 other peer, stopped, sharing start/stop
    When I run "apricity play click.apr --link"
    Then it prints "waiting for the Link session to start"
    And nothing sounds
    When the other peer starts playing
    Then bar 1 of the score sounds on the session's first beat

  Scenario: The DAW stops
    Given the score plays in a session sharing start/stop
    When the other peer stops
    Then Apricity falls silent at the same moment, within the tolerance
    And it prints "Link session stopped; waiting"

  Scenario: Not waiting for start/stop
    Given a Link session at 120 BPM whose peers do not share start/stop
    When I run "apricity play click.apr --link --no-start-stop"
    Then bar 1 of the score sounds on the session's next bar line
    And the session's start and stop are ignored

  Scenario: Quitting Apricity leaves the session playing
    Given the score plays in a session with 1 other peer, playing
    When I press Ctrl-C
    Then the session is still playing and its tempo is unchanged

  Scenario: The quantum
    Given a Link session at 120 BPM, playing
    When I run "apricity play waltz.apr --link" for a score in 3/4
    Then bar 1 of the score lands on a multiple of 3 beats of the session
    When I run it with "--quantum 6"
    Then bar 1 of the score lands on a multiple of 6 beats
```
